name: Monthly/Yearly Accordion Archive & Post Filter, Grid Blocks
author: Akshar Addons

sections.description:
Archive Posts Accordion organizes older WordPress content into expandable monthly and yearly archive panels. Visitors can browse posts by date and load additional results with AJAX without a full page refresh.

Use the accordion on a blog homepage, archive landing page, sidebar, or content area. The free version includes responsive templates, customizable colors, multiple widgets, shortcode support, a Gutenberg block, and an Elementor widget.

🚀 Key Features

  • ✅ Monthly and yearly archive accordion panels.
  • ⚡ AJAX loading for additional archive posts.
  • ↔️ Previous/Next AJAX pagination in the free version.
  • 🧩 Responsive post grid and list layouts.
  • 🎨 Custom heading, month, year, and post title colors.
  • 📱 Multiple widget instances for content areas and sidebars.
  • 🧱 Gutenberg block and Elementor widget support.
  • 🔗 Shortcode support for pages, posts, and templates.
  • 🔎 Archive navigation designed for content discovery.

🧩 Shortcodes

Yearly archive:

[archivespostaccordion widget_title="Yearly Archives" date_format="year" number_of_post_display="8" category_id="0" template="pane_style_1"]

Monthly archive:

[archivespostaccordion widget_title="Monthly Archives" date_format="month_year" number_of_post_display="8" category_id="0" template="pane_style_1"]

🎯 Perfect For

  • Blogs and editorial archives.
  • News and magazine websites.
  • Corporate announcements and press archives.
  • Long-form content libraries.

🔧 How It Works

  1. Edit a page or post.
  2. In Gutenberg, add a Shortcode block. In Elementor or a supported page builder, add a shortcode element.
  3. Paste a monthly or yearly [archivespostaccordion] shortcode.
  4. Select the archive date format, configure the layout, and publish the page.
  5. Visitors can open archive panels and load posts with AJAX.

⭐ Premium Features

Upgrade for more archive control:

  • ⚡ Load More, Previous/Next, and numeric AJAX pagination buttons.
  • 🧱 Custom post type and taxonomy support.
  • 🧱 Elementor widget and Gutenberg block controls for premium settings.
  • 🔎 Search posts by title or category from each archive panel.
  • 🎨 10+ templates and additional hover animation effects.
  • 🔗 Dynamic multiple shortcode creation for content areas.
  • 👁️ Show or hide post counts, empty categories, dates, comments, author names, and author images.
  • ↕️ Sort archive results by month or year in ascending or descending order.
  • ⭐ Open a selected month or year by default and add an All panel.
  • 🖼️ Controls for post image, title, excerpt, pagination, and read more link.
  • ↔️ RTL support and adjustable spacing between post items.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Edit a page or post and add a Gutenberg Shortcode block, Elementor shortcode element, or supported page builder shortcode element.
  4. Paste one of the [archivespostaccordion] shortcode examples.
  5. Configure the archive date format, layout, and categories, then publish the page.
sections.faq:
Can I show monthly and yearly archive panels?

Yes. Use date_format=”month_year” for monthly archives or date_format=”year” for yearly archives.

Can I use shortcodes on pages?

Yes. Add the shortcode to a Gutenberg Shortcode block, a page builder shortcode element, or post content.

Can I use multiple archive widgets?

Yes. Multiple accordion widgets can be placed in different widget areas and content sections.
